# StegCore Issue Templates v1.2 (VISIBLE)
**Status:** Planned
**Generated:** 2026-01-12

Some iPhone unzip tools hide folders that start with a dot (like `.github`).
So this pack ships templates in a visible folder:

`ISSUE_TEMPLATES/`

## Install into GitHub
1) Create `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/` in your StegCore repo
2) Upload ALL files from `ISSUE_TEMPLATES/` into `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`
3) Commit
Then go to **Issues → New issue** and pick a template.
